# appsignal_app (Resource)

An AppSignal app: one name in one environment. The API cannot rename an app, so changing any argument replaces it. Destroying an app deletes all of its data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_app" "web" {
  organization_slug = "example"
  name              = "web"
  environment       = "production"

  lifecycle {
    # Destroying an app deletes all of its data.
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `organization_slug` (String) Slug of the organization the app belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `frontend_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Front-end API key for browser error reporting.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `push_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Push API key that integrations and collectors report with.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_app.web <app_id>
```
